The text damage lives in Punjab and Haryana (56.0%) and Karnataka (49.7%), which contribute zero failure cases. The retrieval benchmark and the text-damage exposure DO NOT OVERLAP.
populationMismatch.implication: No conclusion about retrieval quality drawn from this checkpoint generalises to the High Court corpus, which is 99.56% of staged rows. NEW3 v2 gold is High Court (Allahabad, Jharkhand, Punjab and Haryana, Madras, Rajasthan, Bombay, Chhattisgarh) and is the first failure population drawn from the courts where the damage actually is. That is an additional reason the 1M checkpoint benchmark matters, independent of scale.
